name: personal-os
install:
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
command -v bun >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq postgresql postgresql-contrib openssl >/dev/null
bun install
start:
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
if [ -f scripts/cloud-agent-start.sh ]; then exec bash scripts/cloud-agent-start.sh; fi
sudo service postgresql start || true
PGPASSWORD=password psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='personal-os'" | grep -q 1 || PGPASSWORD=password psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE "personal-os";"
mkdir -p apps/server apps/web
test -f apps/server/.env || printf 'NODE_ENV=development
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=%s
INTEGRATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY=%s
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:password@127.0.0.1:5432/personal-os
BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000
CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3001
GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY=%s
' "${BETTER_AUTH_SECRET:-$(openssl rand -hex 32)}" "${INTEGRATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-$(openssl rand -hex 32)}" "${GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY:-}" > apps/server/.env
test -f apps/web/.env || printf 'NODE_ENV=development
VITE_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3000
' > apps/web/.env
(cd packages/db && DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:password@127.0.0.1:5432/personal-os}" bun x drizzle-kit push --force)
exec bun run dev
